findings.title: Ownership tests skip when participant processRef is missing
findings.why_it_matters: The sole-owner inference, cross-process flow, nested-scope, and sole-participant cleanup tests use early returns when processRef is absent. A regression that creates participants without processRef would therefore bypass the core assertions and still pass these tests, leaving ownership and cleanup behavior unproven.
evidence: At tests/unit/core/SimpleBpmnEngine.test.ts:324-325, the sole-owner test asserts only kind, then returns when participant.processRef is missing.
The distinct-process test repeats the skip at lines 380-383, and sole-participant cleanup repeats it at lines 627-629.
Those processRef values are the inputs that make the subsequent owner, scope, sequence-flow, and cleanup assertions meaningful.
findings.suggested_fix: Assert participant.processRef (and both buyer/seller processRefs) is defined before narrowing, or throw on an unexpected participant shape instead of returning; apply the same change to each affected test.

findings.title: Lifecycle test omits internal flow persistence after reopen
findings.why_it_matters: The fixture test verifies internal sequence flows before import and only the collaboration message flow after loadDiagram/updateElement. A save/reopen regression could drop Buyer_Flow or Seller_Flow while preserving the message flow, participant ref, and updated task, so the stated flow-survival contract would still appear green.
evidence: The pre-import fixture checks one SequenceFlow per process at tests/unit/core/SimpleBpmnEngine.test.ts:458-461.
After reopen and mutation, assertions at lines 496-501 cover only Message_Order, Process_Seller/participantRef, Seller_Receive name, participant bounds, and plane target.
No post-reopen assertion checks Buyer_Flow/Seller_Flow membership or node ownership.
findings.suggested_fix: After reopen/update, assert both process roots still contain their expected sequence-flow IDs and representative flow nodes retain their ownerId/scopeId in the imported context.

residual_risks: The full Jest suite passes (133 tests), but Jest reports that it did not exit one second after completion because an asynchronous handle remains open.
testing_gaps: Add non-skipping processRef assertions to the ownership-focused tests.
Assert internal sequence-flow and node ownership survival after save/reopen/mutate.
